fields.name: Year
fields.description: {"value":"The academic year when data elements contained in this file are effective.\n","fieldValueType":""}

fields.name: CDSCode
fields.description: {"value":"The 14 digit code developed and maintained by the California Department of Education that serves to uniquely identify each school and district in the state.  The first two digits identify the county, the next five digits identify the school district and the last seven digits identify the school.  School districts will have a CDS code ending in '0000000', indicating the feature is a district and not a school.","fieldValueType":""}

fields.name: SchoolType
fields.description: {"value":"A description of the school type assigned to each school that distinguishes schools based on the specific populations they serve.  The field values are generalized from the \"SchoolType\" field in the California Department of Education (CDE) school directory.  ","fieldValueType":"typeOrCategory"}

fields.name: Status
fields.description: {"value":"The operational status of the school that identifies whether the school is active, closed or pending.  ","fieldValueType":"binary"}

fields.name: Virtual
Street
fields.description: {"value":"The physical address of the school.  This address is used as the address input field for geocoding the school record and assigning X,Y coordinates.","fieldValueType":"locationOrPlaceName"}

fields.name: City
fields.description: {"value":"The city in which the school is physically located.","fieldValueType":"locationOrPlaceName"}

fields.name: Zip
fields.description: {"value":"The zip code in which the school is physically located.","fieldValueType":""}

fields.name: State
fields.description: {"value":"The state in which the school is physically located.","fieldValueType":"locationOrPlaceName"}

fields.name: CountyName
fields.description: {"value":"The name of the county associated with the public school district that operates the school.  This is usually, but not always, the same as the county where the school is physically located.","fieldValueType":"locationOrPlaceName"}

fields.name: CountyNameGeo
fields.description: {"value":"The name of the county where the school is geographically located.  This is usually, but not always, the same as the county that is associated with the school district that operates the school.","fieldValueType":"locationOrPlaceName"}
